The 2017 archive resolves the north and west perimeter beneath present canopy and confirms a separate persistent oval. No image registration shift was fitted. Seasonal mowing and hidden edge differences are covered by 2.5 m interpretation uncertainty.

Current east/south edge is directly visible.
Historical western arc completes the shadowed boundary.
